description: Device keys (Identity 0.54 §5.5, §15.5): for a device name n (6.2) and an anchor context with canonical label A (a group/…, persona/… or pair/… label of 6.1), the device label is device/<n>/<c>, c = "u" || base64url(0x12 0x20 || SHA-256(UTF-8 of A)) (47 characters); edSeed = HKDF-SHA-256(root IKM, salt empty, info "rltp/anchor/ed/" || label, 32 bytes), xSeed likewise under "rltp/anchor/x/" || label; the device key is the Ed25519 did:key of edSeed, its key agreement key the X25519 multikey of xSeed (5.1, 5.2). Regenerate: node scripts/gen-identity-device-keys-vector.mjs (deterministic, from lib/dist); re-derived by conformance/runner.mjs.

inputs.source: root IKM = rootIkm of vectors/identity-derivation.json (the BIP-39 test mnemonic); the sample group is group/<genesisDigestSample> of that file

afterStateLoss.note: the device lost its local state, recovered the synchronized state (9.3) and was told its name (3.3): the same name under the same context re-derives the same label, seeds and keys — it is the same device, its device cards stay valid (5.5)

contextRule.note: one device, two anchor contexts: the context is part of the label, so the two device keys are unrelated — a device key shared across contexts would link the anchors it appears under (5.5, Section 14)

nfc.note: the device name follows 6.2: NFC is applied, so the composed and the decomposed spelling of one name give one label and one key
